## Highlights

- Send durable SMTP notifications for task outcomes, test messages and daemon health, with encrypted transport choices, write-only credentials and recipient-aware retries across CLI, desktop and remote administration.
- Author and inspect tasks, groups, schedules, notification policies and operational state through the expanded CLI; evaluate packaged commands with isolated Windows/WSL fixtures, structured reports and supported 120-second case/two-hour default completion budgets.
- Use the branded go-schedule.io website, searchable documentation and sourced release comparison, alongside reliability corrections for watchers, credential helpers, diagnostics and script payloads.
- Inspect neutral SMTP acceptance details separately from errors, retain partial QA observations and recover with the selected budget and original evidence. Completion allowances increase across CI runners and preparation; exact-target desktop checks, PowerShell completion guidance, MCP session descriptions and pre-tag source validation are corrected.
- Align desktop/build dependencies and Pages publishing actions; retain exact-source staging, candidate identity and checksums. Attended native observations remain untested under the standing native-testing waiver; automated CI and artifact checks remain required.
- Track the original intermittent Windows payload/prerequisite and owned IPC observation failures in [#355](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/issues/355) and [#356](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/issues/356). Their causes remain unconfirmed; improved diagnostics and successful follow-up runs do not establish fixes.

Read the [full changelog](https://github.com/shruggietech/go-schedule/blob/v1.6.0/CHANGELOG.md#160---2026-10-22) for every change.
